description:
The Spanish Inquisition, to put it mildly, has a bad reputation. It's known for its brutality and repression but just how true is the commonly held opinion of them. Also, everyone expected the Spanish Inquisition.

The review was just a paragraph of snarling invective, shrieking about how the whole book was nothing but propaganda pushing "the Black Legend" that the English created to slander Spain.
